documentUploads.requirementLabel: Explain the purpose of the accountant’s letter, including its role in verifying financial information and confirming accuracy
documentUploads.textValue: The accountant’s letter is required by Nedbank for my Revolving Credit Facility application. I am self-employed and declared a monthly net income of R235,000 in my application. Nedbank has requested an accountant’s letter confirming my drawings as proof of income. I can provide my company registration documents; however, the only financial records available for verification are my most recent three months of personal bank statements. Please review these statements and confirm the average monthly drawings/income that can be supported by the transactions reflected in them.
